in_hebrew.name: שרינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Lady, Noblewoman, or Princess derives from the Hebrew root 'shar' meaning 'to sing' and 'rachamim' meaning 'mercy'. The name Sarene signifies a noblewoman who sings praises to the Lord with mercy.

in_greek.name: Σαρενή
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Sarene in Greek is derived from the word 'sarx' meaning 'flesh' or 'body', and 'rhein' meaning 'to flow'. The name Sarene signifies a beautiful and radiant woman, as if her flesh or body was flowing with the beauty and grace of the Lord.

in_latin.name: Sarena
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Sarene in Latin is derived from the word 'sar' meaning 'scarlet' or 'red', and 'valere' meaning 'to be well' or 'to be in good health'. The name Sarene signifies a precious and valuable woman, whose beauty and health remind us of the preciousness and health-giving qualities of the Lord.

in_english.name: Sarene
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sarene in English is derived from the Old French word 'serene', which means 'calm' or 'peaceful'. The name Sarene signifies a calm and peaceful noblewoman, whose tranquility and grace reflect the peace and calmness of the Lord.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sarene, derived from the Greek term 'sar-k-in-ē', carries a rich cultural heritage. Its association with the Assyrian king Sar-en-dar adds a regal and powerful connotation to the name. Historically, the Assyrians have been known for their might and influence in ancient civilizations, and Sarene embodies this legacy by reminding us of the strength, leadership, and conquering spirit of her namesake.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sarene holds deep spiritual significance as well. The term 'scarlet' symbolizes new beginnings and the shedding of old sins, applying to the spiritual journey and transformation that many Christians experience. Moreover, the resilience conveyed by this name can serve as a reminder to Christians to hold onto their faith, lean on God for support during difficult times, and live a life that represents the strength of their faith. Sarene represents not only the power of the past but also the redemption and renewal of the present.
